headline: Salah magic: Egypt secures first-ever World Cup win beating New Zealand 3-1
summary: Mohamed Salah inspires a historic comeback to put Egypt top of Group G, ending a 92-year wait for a victory in the tournament.
details: Mohamed Salah led Egypt to their first-ever World Cup victory on Sunday, recovering from an early deficit to beat New Zealand 3-1.
New Zealand took an early lead in the 15th minute when defender Finn Surman scored a header from a corner, silencing the Egyptian crowd at BC Place.
Egypt fought back in the 58th minute as Mostafa Zizo equalized with a header. Nine minutes later, captain Mohamed Salah scored a powerful left-footed finish to take the lead.
Trezeguet sealed the victory with a superb header from a Salah corner, completing the 3-1 win and marking a historic milestone for the nation.
With this win, Egypt moves to the top of Group G with four points from two matches, following a 1-1 draw in their opening game against Belgium.
New Zealand, who drew 2-2 with Iran in their first match, now sit at the bottom of the group with only one point.
caption:
A 92-year wait is over! Egypt secures its first-ever World Cup victory with a thrilling 3-1 comeback against New Zealand.

Mohamed Salah led Egypt to their first-ever World Cup victory on Sunday, recovering from an early deficit to beat New Zealand 3-1.

New Zealand took an early lead in the 15th minute when defender Finn Surman scored a header from a corner, silencing the Egyptian crowd at BC Place.

Egypt fought back in the 58th minute as Mostafa Zizo equalized with a header. Nine minutes later, captain Mohamed Salah scored a powerful left-footed finish to take the lead.

Trezeguet sealed the victory with a superb header from a Salah corner, completing the 3-1 win and marking a historic milestone for the nation.

With this win, Egypt moves to the top of Group G with four points from two matches, following a 1-1 draw in their opening game against Belgium.

New Zealand, who drew 2-2 with Iran in their first match, now sit at the bottom of the group with only one point.

headline_marked: Gold prices jump by 4,432 BDT, [[22K gold now 230,772 BDT per bhori]]
headline: Gold prices jump by 4,432 BDT, 22K gold now 230,772 BDT per bhori
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has increased gold prices following a rise in the global market, ending a period of decline.
details: The price of 22-carat gold in Bangladesh has increased by 4,432 BDT per bhori, effective from 10 AM today. The price has risen to 230,772 BDT per bhori from the previous 226,340 BDT.
// The price of 21-carat gold is now 220,391 BDT per bhori, while 18-carat gold is priced at 189,248 BDT. Traditional gold is now 154,606 BDT per bhori.

The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) adjusted the prices due to an increase in pure gold prices on the global market. This follows a period where prices had decreased four times after Eid-ul-Adha, and then increased three times.
According to BAJUS, these prices will remain in effect until further notice. Making charges will apply based on the design of the jewelry, and VAT is already included in these prices.
In the proposed budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year, the VAT on gold has been reduced to 2,500 BDT per bhori, down from the previous 5% rate.
Silver prices remain unchanged today, with 22-carat silver priced at 5,249 BDT per bhori.
